data.name: Smite Evil
data.description: A hunting paladin gains this ability at 4th level, and it functions at her paladin level - 3. She can expend a daily use of smite evil to gain an additional daily use of hunt evil. She can use smite evil and hunt evil against the same target. This alters smite evil.
